tips: | Kites you, saves people from oneshots, kites you more, cc's enough to kill you 5 times over. Avoid.
| 10 years of cc and an ultimate to outscale you to the moon in the teamfight. Either you oneshot him before teamfights or you lose the game.
| AP 5, AD 3. AP Shaco is zone control and CC to the maximum, both of which you hate playing against. AD Shaco's who max their W last are not a big problem.

| She beats you in the earlygame. A good kindred wont give you a chance to do a single full clear, and at lvl 6 she has outscaled you. After your first clear on a raptorfight or a river skirmish is your only chance to get ahead.
| CC and zone control extraordinaire.
| He beats you in the 1v1, he outganks you, he outskirmishes you. You win at full build but before then it's entirely unplayable. I'm glad no one plays him.
| While she won't beat you in the 1v1, she WILL outgank you. So either read her movements well and prepare for counterganks or lose to your team losing all their lanes.
| She is an extremely strong gank and if she catches you off guard in your jungle during your first clear she can kill you. Played well you can beat her, and you outscale at 2 items.

| Champion has 3 HP bars. He can heal your whole combo with a well timed W, then beat you in the extended fight. He can avoid your oneshots while also rolling you over with the slightest lead. Unfavourable.
| Only a problem with a team thats ahead. He will never beat you in the 1v1, but he can cc you for days. If you catch him off guard you can surprise him with a oneshot.
| Never beats you on his own, but he can kite you easily. His ultimate is the bane of your existence, and he outganks you.
| A good viego can kite you. An extremely well rounded jungler that can destroy you with a lead.

| Blue kayn 4, red kayn 3. You can never touch a blue kayn, you will need to get ahead in the earlygame, which shouldn't be a problem. Red kayn has tons of cc and untargetability, but you should come out on top in the 1v1.

| If he gets a lead you're toast. A Kha with a lead will oneshot you in his invisibility, and you cant do a thing about it. If you're ahead though, the roles are reversed the moment you get an empowered Q off.

| A zone control mage. Udyr doesn't like playing into zone control. But she has no mobility, and her only actual form of cc can be dodged with awaken E. You beat her in the 1v1 always, but she can be problematic in teamfights and skirmishes.
| If she gets a lead she will oneshot you. Usual Evelynn gameplay.
| If you aren't ahead enough to oneshot him in one rotation he beats you in the 1v1. If you get full build you will beat him. But he is still Master Yi, and no one enjoys playing vs Master Yi.
| Will oneshot you with a lead. You win in extended fights, but the fights wont be extended if he is up 5 kills. Try to go for counterganks.
| He will outgank you. If he doesn't get a lead he loses out to you in everything. But it's quite easy for a Nunu to get a lead.
| He can kill you if he's up 5 kills. If he's up 4 kills, you still beat him. His R is an annoyance but he really isn't that much of a worry, unless he's getting all his lanes ahead in the earlygame.
| As long as you don't die on first clear you don't have much to worry about.

| You beat him up hard in the earlygame, one of the only champs I'm looking to invade early against. Get a lead, snowball into a win. If you let the game go long he will outscale you in the teamfight.

| His spellshield is extremely annoying to play versus, and he can turn the game around after lvl 6 no matter how ahead you think you are. He doesn't beat you in the 1v1, but you can never catch him with his W and E.
| Catch her off guard and oneshot her. If you let her teamfight then she will outscale.
| He will outscale, but is extremely vulnerable before zhonyas. Beat him early.
| Zone control mage. Outscales you, and is good at avoiding fighting you. Get a lead early or prepare for a difficult game.
| You should beat her if she invades you, but your laners might get dove on repeat so look to deny her that advantage. You hard outscale.
| Not a threat on her own, but always a capable cc bot. Not an enjoyable matchup.
| Her W can stun your E, and her ultimate is really annoying to play versus. A capable cc bot but not a threat on her own.
| Itemize black cleaver and serylda and you will oneshot him.
| A cc bot, but sucks earlygame. You shouldn't ever be behind vs an Amumu.
| Kite his damage reduction and you win fights. Try to save your awaken Q until he is about half HP so he can't lifesteal up.
| High 3. Super annoying to deal with, but you can force his ult extremely easily.
| Super strong early gank that can ult you away after 6. Slightly annoying but not a problem in the 1v1.
| A champ with little to no cc and weak mobility? Sign me up. You oneshot him all game long.
| Super weak early and after Duskblade you oneshot him before he has a chance to R.
| A burst mage without enough burst to oneshot you who also has to get in melee range to fight. You will enjoy your game versus this champion.
| Super weak early and you oneshot her come midgame.
| You beat him all game long.
| Unless you let her get 6 items you should be able to beat her always. Unless she goes AP, in which case, oh well, she will poke you with E.
| Don't get outganked and you beat him in the 1v1.
| You are your own one man army. You don't need teammates. You're here to farm up and 1v9. A Yuumi can tag along, if she so wishes. Other than that I don't see a need for teammates.
